verdict.rationale: Fathom publishes a structured per-endpoint API reference (meetings, recordings, webhooks, teams, users) generated from OpenAPI-style definitions, plus a quickstart for making a first call. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser 'try it' console. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the reference, runnable request examples on endpoint pages, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Create a webhook to receive new meeting content. At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
Returns meetings whose associated company matches one of the specified domains.
Generate an API key and make your first call
